messages:
Maya (AE): NovusBank asked for a short POC to migrate from VendorX to Redwood. Main asks: minimal adapter, parity on prompts + function-calls, cost delta, security questionnaire, and a rollback runbook. Can SE + Eng triage?

Ibrahim (Sales Eng): I'll run SE. Suggest a 10-business-day POC: 1) tiny shim proxy to accept VendorX schema, 2) run 200 golden prompts through both systems, 3) cost delta report, 4) security questionnaire filled, 5) 48h canary in eu-west.

Claire (NovusBank Eng): We need EU-only residency, Okta SSO + SCIM, KMS CMK, and egress IP allowlist. Also front-end relies on streaming flush points.

Sofia (Platform): Adapter note: VendorX posts body.conversation and header X-Session. Redwood expects model+messages. We can ship a ~120-line shim to map conversation->messages, normalize roles, and translate function-calls. Example pseudo:```
const msgs = body.conversation.map(m=>({role:m.role,content:m.text}));
fetch(redwood, {model:'rwd-1', messages: msgs});
```
That keeps integration minimal.

Liam (Security): Send them our questionnaire: https://redwood.internal/sec-q. Primary asks: SOC2, pen-test summary, CMK support, VPC peering or Private deployment options, log retention and PII redaction. Also confirm audit log TTL.

Ibrahim (Sales Eng): Commercials: if they commit to Dedicated for 6+ months we can offer reserved pricing plus a migration credit (typically cover up to 40 eng hours). I'll propose a credit in the handoff.

Sofia (Platform): Parity plan: three buckets - 1) exact match for templated flows, 2) semantic similarity for free-form (embedding cosine >= 0.85), 3) function-calling contract checks (schema + invocation frequency). We'll run an A/B harness and output pass/fail CSV with sample diffs.

Claire (NovusBank Eng): We'll provide a 72h traffic dump and a set of 250 golden prompts. Also legal will start the questionnaire today.

Sofia (Platform): For billing delta we'll token-count their dump and show hosted vs reserved pricing. We'll also include options for smaller quantized models to show cost/latency tradeoffs. Need the dump to produce numbers (48h turnaround after receipt).

deploy-bot: staging-novus-eu created (eu-west-1)

Liam (Security): Clarification: if they require HSM-backed CMKs, that likely pushes to Private deployment and affects timeline. Call that out in the runbook.

Maya (AE): Eng availability? Can Platform allocate ~0.5 FTE for week1 and 0.25 for canary monitoring?

Sofia (Platform): Confirmed 0.5 FTE week1, on-call for canary. Will prepare tokenization script and parity harness.

Ibrahim (Sales Eng): I'll draft the kickoff packet, include the migration credit term, sec questionnaire link, and the simple shim example.

Maya (AE): Great, Claire: once you drop the dump and prompts we'll lock kickoff next Tuesday. Thanks all :thumbsup:
